title: Poe Dameron
subtitle: The Resistance
description: Poe Dameron led the fighter and bomber attack against the First Order Dreadnought Fulminatrix in order to cover the Resistance escape from their base in D'Qar. Unfortunately, he disobeyed direct orders and cost many lives. After being demoted and learning the truth of the strategies being employed around him, he learned his lesson and helped save the Resistance.
